create_OwlViTImageProcessorPil: create an OwlViTImageProcessorPil instance for preprocessing images for object detection with OWL-ViT
run_post_process_object_detection: run post_process_object_detection to convert OWL-ViT model outputs into final bounding boxes with confidence scores
run_post_process_image_guided_detection: run post_process_image_guided_detection to convert OWL-ViT image-guided detection outputs into COCO-format results with NMS filtering
build_scale_boxes: build scaled bounding boxes from normalized coordinates to absolute pixel coordinates using target image sizes
test_box_iou: test box_iou to compute pairwise IoU between two sets of bounding boxes in x1,y1,x2,y2 format
